# ffxf_database_metrics (Data Source)

Reads FFXF Cloud database API data. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_database_metrics" "current" {
  database_id = 42
  range       = "1h"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) ID of the database to query.

### Optional

- `range` (String) Metrics time range: 1h, 24h (default), or 7d.

### Read-Only

- `metrics_json` (String) Database metrics and time-series points as JSON.
